regions.name: Goblinwood

regions.name: Bone-Rattle Marches
regions.description: Crypts, necromancers, soul fire, and skeletons with increasingly concerning job titles.

regions.name: Spookington
regions.description: Haunted halls, angry paintings, possessed furniture, Lady Morvena.

regions.description: Snow forts, blizzards, frost monsters, and at least one angry snowman.

regions.name: Toasty Dragon Lands
regions.description: Lava, ash storms, dragon ruins and a campaign finale that gets legitimately dangerous.

dayJobs.name: Mining
dayJobs.flavor: Yes, enemies can interrupt you. Yes, your party can complain.

dayJobs.name: Herbalism
dayJobs.flavor: Gather regional herbs for potions, crafting and higher-tier recipes.

events.name: Wagon Wheel Wipeout
events.description: Goblins are trying to steal the rest of Pip's wagon. Defend it!
events.startBark: HERE THEY COME! Protect the wheels! The other wheels!
events.successBark: We did it! I mean, YOU did it! I supervised!
events.failBark: My wagon! It's... it's in pieces. More pieces. Ugh.

potion.name: Questionable Health Potion
potion.description: Restores 40% health. Tastes like a dare.
